import urllib.request as ur
import urllib.parse as up
import http.cookiejar
import hashlib
import json
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

# Use a different UA fingerprint (Firefox)
USER_AGENT = 'Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:128.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/128.0'
DATA_DIR = Path('tasks/t0103_extract_baden_2016_ds_morphologies/data')

def solve_pow(challenge_data: str, difficulty: int) -> tuple[str, int]:
    half = difficulty // 2
    odd = difficulty % 2 != 0
    nonce = 0
    while True:
        h = hashlib.sha256(f'{challenge_data}{nonce}'.encode()).digest()
        ok = True
        for s in range(half):
            if h[s] != 0:
                ok = False
                break
        if ok and odd and (h[half] >> 4) != 0:
            ok = False
        if ok:
            return h.hex(), nonce
        nonce += 1

cj = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
opener = ur.build_opener(ur.HTTPCookieProcessor(cj))
opener.addheaders = [
    ('User-Agent', USER_AGENT),
    ('Accept', 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8'),
    ('Accept-Language', 'en-US,en;q=0.5'),
    ('Accept-Encoding', 'gzip, deflate, br'),
    ('DNT', '1'),
    ('Upgrade-Insecure-Requests', '1'),
    ('Sec-Fetch-Dest', 'document'),
    ('Sec-Fetch-Mode', 'navigate'),
    ('Sec-Fetch-Site', 'none'),
    ('Sec-Fetch-User', '?1'),
]

print('Step 1: visit dataset page')
with opener.open(ur.Request('https://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.d9v38'), timeout=30) as r:
    print(f'  status={r.status}, ct={r.headers.get("Content-Type")}, len_body={len(r.read())}')
time.sleep(3)

target = 'https://datadryad.org/downloads/file_stream/3407'
print(f'Step 2: fetch {target}')
req = ur.Request(target, headers={'Referer': 'https://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.d9v38'})
with opener.open(req, timeout=30) as r:
    final = r.url
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    body = r.read()
print(f'  final={final[:80]}, ct={ct}, len={len(body)}')
print(f'  first 100 bytes: {body[:100]!r}')

# Try one decompress attempt in case it's gzip
if body[:2] == b'\x1f\x8b':
    import gzip
    body = gzip.decompress(body)
    print('  decompressed gzip')

is_anubis = b'anubis_challenge' in body
is_waf = b'awsWafCookie' in body or b'AwsWafIntegration' in body
is_pdf = body[:4] == b'%PDF'
print(f'  is_anubis={is_anubis}, is_waf={is_waf}, is_pdf={is_pdf}')

if is_anubis:
    body_str = body.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
    m = re.search(r'<script id="anubis_challenge" type="application/json">(.+?)</script>', body_str, re.DOTALL)
    ch_data = json.loads(m.group(1).strip())
    ch = ch_data['challenge']
    t0 = time.time()
    hash_hex, nonce = solve_pow(ch['randomData'], ch_data['rules']['difficulty'])
    elapsed_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    print(f'  PoW solved: nonce={nonce}, {elapsed_ms}ms')
    params = {'id': ch['id'], 'response': hash_hex, 'nonce': str(nonce), 'redir': target, 'elapsedTime': str(elapsed_ms)}
    pass_url = 'https://datadryad.org/.within.website/x/cmd/anubis/api/pass-challenge?' + up.urlencode(params)
    class NR(ur.HTTPRedirectHandler):
        def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
            return None
    op_nr = ur.build_opener(ur.HTTPCookieProcessor(cj), NR)
    op_nr.addheaders = opener.addheaders
    try:
        op_nr.open(ur.Request(pass_url, headers={'Referer': final}), timeout=30).read()
    except ur.HTTPError as e:
        if e.code != 302:
            raise
    time.sleep(2)
    print('Step 3: re-fetch')
    req = ur.Request(target, headers={'Referer': 'https://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.d9v38'})
    with opener.open(req, timeout=60) as r:
        final = r.url
        ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        cl = r.headers.get('Content-Length')
        body = r.read()
    print(f'  final={final[:80]}..., ct={ct}, cl={cl}, len={len(body)}')
    print(f'  first 16 bytes: {body[:16]!r}')
    is_pdf = body[:4] == b'%PDF'
    is_waf = b'awsWafCookie' in body or b'AwsWafIntegration' in body
    print(f'  is_pdf={is_pdf}, is_waf={is_waf}')

if body[:4] == b'%PDF':
    out = DATA_DIR / 'README_for_BadenEtAl_RGCs_2016_v1.pdf'
    out.write_bytes(body)
    print(f'\nSUCCESS Saved {out}: {len(body)} bytes, sha256={hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()}')
else:
    print('\nFAIL: response is not a PDF')
